principle: Off-screen Academy life is deterministic execution of already-valid state, not narrative fabrication.
rules: Catch-up only evaluates time inside the requested closed-open interval.
Events are ordered deterministically by time then stable id.
No event absent from authoritative inputs is invented for pacing.
NPC autonomy operates only inside already-defined eligibility, schedule, capacity and relationship rules.
Elapsed time alone cannot create relationship transitions, grades, qualifications, progression or discipline.
Campus events must already exist under Step 15 before off-screen execution can reference them.
Obligation evidence produced off-screen is consumed by Step 14 rather than bypassing it.
Wellbeing consumes confirmed resolved activity rather than elapsed time.
Latent/materialized state changes detail only, never outcome truth.
Off-screen execution cannot leak hidden World Truth into observer knowledge.
